I answered Marcus in a thread on their message in #north-team: the contact for the door 6 duplicate arrivals is **Thea Ramaswell** at Quarrendon Freight Lines.

That comes from Dana's post in #north-team on Aug 20, 2025, a channel Marcus belongs to. Dana wrote that Thea had flagged duplicate arrivals on door 6 on the morning shift. The same trailer showed up twice at 06:30 because the driver checked in at the kiosk and then dispatch added him by hand. Dana said she was handling it herself, so I told Marcus to check with her for anything newer.

I didn't include Thea's job title. It appears only in a brain note written for Ruth, not in anything Marcus can see.
